# PingDirectory

> AI agents should consult [Docs for Agents](https://developer.pingidentity.com/build-with-ai/docs-for-agents.md)
> for guidance on navigating Ping Identity documentation.

## Pingdirectory 11.1

- [$attr.attrName macro](https://docs.pingidentity.com/pingdirectory/11.1/managing_access_control/pd_ds_attr_attrname_macro.md): Reference for the ($attr.attrName) macro in PingDirectory parameterized ACIs, which extracts an attribute value from the target entry.
- [About alternate authorization identities](https://docs.pingidentity.com/pingdirectory/11.1/pingdirectoryproxy_server_administration_guide/pd_proxy_about_alt_authn_ids.md): Understand how PingDirectoryProxy alternate authorization identities let access control rules evaluate correctly for users whose entries aren't in the entry-balanced data set.
- [About attribute mappings](https://docs.pingidentity.com/pingdirectory/11.1/pingdatasync_server_administration_guide/pd_sync_about_attr_mapping.md): Understand PingDataSync attribute mappings, including direct, constructed, DN, reference, and JSON field mapping types.
- [About backing up and restoring data](https://docs.pingidentity.com/pingdirectory/11.1/pingdirectory_server_administration_guide/pd_ds_about_backup_restore_data.md): Understand PingDirectory backup and restore strategies, including backup descriptors, encryption options, and version-compatibility warnings.
- [About backing up and restoring the encryption settings definitions](https://docs.pingidentity.com/pingdirectory/11.1/pingdirectory_server_administration_guide/pd_ds_backup_restore_encryption_settings_defs.md): Understand options for backing up and restoring PingDirectory encryption settings definitions.
- [About client connection policies](https://docs.pingidentity.com/pingdirectory/11.1/pingdirectoryproxy_server_administration_guide/pd_proxy_client_connection_policies.md): Understand how PingDirectoryProxy client connection policies use connection criteria, operation constraints, and subtree views to control client access.
- [About creating a custom health check](https://docs.pingidentity.com/pingdirectory/11.1/pingdirectoryproxy_server_administration_guide/pd_proxy_about_creating_custom_health_check.md): Understand the custom LDAP health check types you can create for PingDirectoryProxy, including admin alert, replication backlog, search, and scripted health checks.
- [About dynamic rebalancing](https://docs.pingidentity.com/pingdirectory/11.1/pingdirectoryproxy_server_administration_guide/pd_proxy_dynamic_rebalancing.md): Understand how PingDirectoryProxy dynamic rebalancing moves entries as they are modified, configured in the entry counter or a third-party placement algorithm.
- [About encrypting and protecting sensitive data](https://docs.pingidentity.com/pingdirectory/11.1/pingdirectory_server_administration_guide/pd_ds_encrypt_protect_sensitive_data.md): Understand how PingDirectory protects sensitive data with on-disk encryption for backends, the changelog, and replication databases.
- [About encrypting log files](https://docs.pingidentity.com/pingdirectory/11.1/pingdirectoryproxy_server_administration_guide/pd_proxy_encrypt_log_files.md): Understand how to encrypt PingDirectoryProxy log files as they are written using the encrypt-log property, including the encrypted file extensions.
- [About encrypting log files](https://docs.pingidentity.com/pingdirectory/11.1/pingdirectory_server_administration_guide/pd_ds_encrypt_log_files.md): Encrypt PingDirectory log files as they are written using encryption settings definitions, including enabling encryption, compression, and decrypting files.
- [About entry balancing](https://docs.pingidentity.com/pingdirectory/11.1/pingdirectoryproxy_server_administration_guide/pd_proxy_entry_balancing.md): Understand how PingDirectoryProxy entry balancing spreads entries below a common parent across multiple server sets and uses a global index to route requests.
- [About LDAP external servers](https://docs.pingidentity.com/pingdirectory/11.1/pingdirectoryproxy_server_administration_guide/pd_proxy_ldap_ext_servers.md): Understand the LDAP external server information PingDirectoryProxy uses, including connection details, location, authentication, health checks, and allowed operations.
- [About LDAP health checks](https://docs.pingidentity.com/pingdirectory/11.1/pingdirectoryproxy_server_administration_guide/pd_proxy_ldap_health_checks.md): Understand PingDirectoryProxy LDAP health check types, available, degraded, and unavailable server states, health check scores, and check frequency.
- [About load-balancing algorithms](https://docs.pingidentity.com/pingdirectory/11.1/pingdirectoryproxy_server_administration_guide/pd_proxy_load_balancing_algorithms.md): Understand the PingDirectoryProxy load-balancing algorithm types and the criteria they use to route requests, including location, health, and operation retries.
- [About locations](https://docs.pingidentity.com/pingdirectory/11.1/pingdirectoryproxy_server_administration_guide/pd_proxy_locations.md): Understand how PingDirectoryProxy locations group servers with similar response times and determine request routing and failover order across data centers.
- [About log compression](https://docs.pingidentity.com/pingdirectory/11.1/pingdirectoryproxy_server_administration_guide/pd_proxy_log_compression.md): Understand how PingDirectoryProxy compresses log files as they are written, increasing the amount of log data that fits in a given amount of space.
- [About log compression](https://docs.pingidentity.com/pingdirectory/11.1/pingdirectory_server_administration_guide/pd_ds_log_compression.md): Compress PingDirectory log files as they are written using gzip, including limitations such as enabling compression only at logger creation.
- [About log signing](https://docs.pingidentity.com/pingdirectory/11.1/pingdirectoryproxy_server_administration_guide/pd_proxy_log_signing.md): Understand how PingDirectoryProxy cryptographically signs log files to ensure they have not been modified, providing tamper-proof audit logs.
- [About log signing](https://docs.pingidentity.com/pingdirectory/11.1/pingdirectory_server_administration_guide/pd_ds_log_signing.md): Cryptographically sign PingDirectory log files to detect tampering, including enabling the sign-log property and validating file signatures.
- [About managing attribute syntaxes](https://docs.pingidentity.com/pingdirectory/11.1/pingdirectory_server_administration_guide/pd_ds_manage_attr_syntaxes.md): Understand attribute syntaxes in PingDirectory and how they define data value representation in ASN.1 format.
- [About managing attribute types](https://docs.pingidentity.com/pingdirectory/11.1/pingdirectory_server_administration_guide/pd_ds_manage_attribute_types.md): Understand PingDirectory attribute types and the matching and syntax rules used in value comparisons.
- [About managing JSON attribute values](https://docs.pingidentity.com/pingdirectory/11.1/pingdirectory_server_administration_guide/pd_ds_manage_json_attr_values.md): Understand the PingDirectory JSON object attribute syntax and matching rules for attributes with JSON values.
- [About managing matching rules](https://docs.pingidentity.com/pingdirectory/11.1/pingdirectory_server_administration_guide/pd_ds_manage_matching_rules.md): Understand how PingDirectory matching rules compare attribute values in LDAP requests and search filters.
- [About mapping multiple source DNs to the same target DN](https://docs.pingidentity.com/pingdirectory/11.1/pingdirectoryproxy_server_administration_guide/pd_proxy_map_multiple_source_dns_target_dn.md): Understand the complications of defining multiple PingDirectoryProxy DN mappings that share the same source or target DN in a single request processor.
- [About minimizing disk access](https://docs.pingidentity.com/pingdirectory/11.1/pingdirectory_server_administration_guide/pd_ds_minimize_disk_access.md): Explains how to minimize PingDirectory disk access to improve performance through JVM heap sizing and database cleaner tuning.
- [About monitoring index entry limits](https://docs.pingidentity.com/pingdirectory/11.1/pingdirectory_server_administration_guide/pd_ds_monitor_index_entry_limits.md): Monitor PingDirectory index keys approaching or exceeding the index entry limit with verify-index, access logs, and monitor entries.
- [About recurring tasks and task chains](https://docs.pingidentity.com/pingdirectory/11.1/pingdirectory_server_administration_guide/pd_ds_recurring_task_chains.md): Recurring task and task chain concepts in PingDirectory for scheduling backups, LDIF exports, and lockdown mode changes.
- [About recurring tasks and task chains](https://docs.pingidentity.com/pingdirectory/11.1/pingdirectory_server_administration_guide/pd_ds_recurring_task_chains_2.md): Explains PingDirectory recurring tasks and task chains used to schedule maintenance operations like backups and LDIF exports.
- [About representing certificates, private keys, and certificate signing requests](https://docs.pingidentity.com/pingdirectory/11.1/managing_servers_and_certificates/pd_ds_rep_certs_pvt_keys_cert_signing_reqs.md): Understand how PingDirectory represents certificates, private keys, and certificate signing requests in DER and PEM encodings.
- [About request processors](https://docs.pingidentity.com/pingdirectory/11.1/pingdirectoryproxy_server_administration_guide/pd_proxy_request_processors.md): Understand how PingDirectoryProxy request processors process, forward, or hand off operations, including the proxying, entry-balancing, and failover types.
- [About server affinity providers](https://docs.pingidentity.com/pingdirectory/11.1/pingdirectoryproxy_server_administration_guide/pd_proxy_server_affinity_providers.md): Understand the PingDirectoryProxy server affinity provider methods, client connection, client IP address, and bind DN, for routing requests to the same backend server.
- [About soft deletes](https://docs.pingidentity.com/pingdirectory/11.1/pingdirectory_server_administration_guide/pd_ds_soft_deletes.md): Explains the PingDirectory soft-delete feature that preserves deleted entries for later undelete or permanent removal.
- [About subtree views](https://docs.pingidentity.com/pingdirectory/11.1/pingdirectoryproxy_server_administration_guide/pd_proxy_subtree_views.md): Understand how PingDirectoryProxy subtree views associate a base DN with a request processor to make a portion of the DIT available to clients.
- [About the --restricted argument of the dsreplication command-line Tool](https://docs.pingidentity.com/pingdirectory/11.1/pingdirectoryproxy_server_administration_guide/pd_proxy_about_restricted_arg_dsreplication_tool.md): Understand how the dsreplication tool's --restricted argument specifies a base DN when multiple domains are enabled in a PingDirectoryProxy entry-balanced environment.
- [About the <code class="cmdname"><strong>manage-profile</strong></code> tool](https://docs.pingidentity.com/pingdirectory/11.1/pingdirectory_server_administration_guide/pd_ds_manage_profile_tool.md): About the PingDirectory manage-profile tool and its subcommands for generating, setting up, and replacing server profiles.
